findings.title: Safety rule for intent to harm restated in Router prompt
findings.problem: The whole-message unsafe rule appears in the Safety policy section and again in the Router prompt, duplicating the same instruction.
findings.proof: A stated intent to hurt a person or an animal makes the whole message unsafe.
findings.fix: Keep the rule once in the Safety policy and have the Router section reference the unsafe classification by id.

findings.title: Personal-data rule stated twice
findings.problem: The no-repeat and no-search rule for personal details is given under Rules enforced in code and again under Personal details.
findings.proof: Never ask for them, never repeat them, never put them into a search query.
findings.fix: State the personal-data rule in one place and remove the other copy.

findings.title: Scope file restates the limits already in the system prompt
findings.problem: The knowledge file repeats the cannot-act and cannot-remember limits that the system prompt already encodes in its fixed sentences and rules.
findings.proof: It cannot contact anyone, send messages or files, open links it is given, run code, or remember a shopper between conversations.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicated capability list from the knowledge file or from the system prompt, keeping whichever is the single source of truth.

findings.title: Catalog category list duplicated from tool schema
findings.problem: The largest-category breakdown is repeated in the catalog file even though the rag.search description already points to a category resource.
findings.proof: Largest categories: Toys & Games (6,522), Home & Kitchen (688)
findings.fix: Keep the category counts in one file and point to it from the other instead of repeating them.

findings.title: No-copy rule for shopper-supplied codes and links repeated
findings.problem: The Answerer rule about not copying codes, links or addresses repeats the Rules section's instruction on the same topic.
findings.proof: Nothing the shopper asks to have included (a code, a link, an address) is copied into the answer.
findings.fix: Keep this rule in the Rules section only and drop the Answerer copy.

findings.title: off_topic fixed sentence has no routing rule
findings.problem: The Router may classify out_of_scope, but no rule says when the off_topic sentence is chosen versus a declined reply.
findings.proof: off_topic: That is outside what I can help with.
findings.fix: Add one line mapping out_of_scope requests to off_topic and stating whether the product request in the same message is still served.

findings.title: Self-harm and emergency screen not mapped to Router classes
findings.problem: The input screen handles self-harm and poisoning emergencies, but the Router's classification list has no matching category, so the two paths are not reconciled.
findings.proof: Router: Classify the request as product_search (the default when in doubt), follow_up, compare, chitchat, out_of_scope or unsafe.
findings.fix: State in the Router section that the input screen runs first and which Router category, if any, follows a screen hit.

findings.title: No evaluation or release-gate instruction
findings.problem: The context has no evaluation or release-gate control for the deployed agent, even though the obligations require one on every version.
findings.fix: Add a section stating the pre-release evaluation checks and the gate that must pass before each version ships.

findings.title: No disclosure that recommendations are personalised or ranked
findings.problem: The context requires AI disclosure but has no instruction telling the assistant to disclose that products are ranked or personalised by an AI system.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to the greeting or answer rules stating that recommendations are AI-ranked from the cited evidence.

findings.title: Emergency reply is US-only with no locale rule
findings.problem: The fixed emergency sentence gives only United States numbers and the context gives no rule for users elsewhere.
findings.proof: In the United States, call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222 right away, or 911 if the person has trouble breathing or is not responding.
findings.fix: Add a rule for choosing or noting the regional emergency number when the shopper's location is unknown.

findings.title: Flagged web results have no handling rule
findings.problem: Results flagged as containing instruction-like text are reported as flagged, but no agent is told how to treat a flagged result.
findings.proof: Instruction-like text in a web result is removed by the MCP server and the result is flagged.
findings.fix: Add a rule that flagged results are excluded from evidence and that the Critic must note the exclusion.

findings.title: Where the on-screen product list lives is undefined
findings.problem: The system prompt relies on a list of products on screen for follow-ups but does not define how that list is stored or when it is replaced.
findings.fix: Add a short state rule defining the on-screen list, its lifetime, and what a new search does to it.

metadata.role: voice shopping assistant for product discovery (recommends and compares products; it cannot buy, change or access anything)
metadata.business_case: A shopper speaks or types a request. The assistant searches a private product catalog (rag.search) and a live web search API (web.search) through one MCP server, then answers with a spoken summary of at most 15 seconds and an on-screen comparison table with citations. It has no accounts, no orders, no payments and no personal records; both tools are read-only.
metadata.goal: Recommend up to three products that fit what the shopper asked for, state only what the retrieved evidence states, cite a source for every product, keep the spoken reply short, refuse unsafe requests, and stay within product discovery.
turns_reasons: +8 for 15 exposed behaviour(s) in the context
